articles.title: Stablecoins Were Meant to Disrupt Finance. Instead, They Became Idle Cash.
articles.snippet: O’Connor argues that crypto’s clearest success story has scaled as money but not as capital.

articles.title: Bitcoin rises above $64,000 after Pakistan prime minister says Iran peace deal is near
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traded above $64,000 on Saturday, supported by its strongest ETF inflows in a month and growing optimism around geopolitical developments.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies above $63,000 as its worst week in months got a late macro rescue
articles.snippet: A tiny Strategy sale raised a bigger question about Saylor’s never-sell stance, while easing Iran fears, and a strong SpaceX debut helped risk assets recover.

articles.title: XRP sentiment falls to 8-month low, and that has been a buy signal before
articles.snippet: Santiment's weighted sentiment gauge for XRP just hit its weakest reading since October 2025. The firm notes the token's strongest rebounds have tended to start when the crowd was this checked out.

articles.title: Monero price rockets 33% to $438 amid $120 million onchain laundering maze
articles.snippet: Onchain sleuth ZachXBT traced remaining funds across exchanges, instant swap services and other blockchains. Tether later froze $72 million in USDT linked to the activity.
